name: alphaai
description: A local, agentic, Claude-like assistant powered by your own Qwen model via Ollama.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run server" "npm run web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/cli
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @alphaai/web
